{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies public interfaces in src/interfaces/wallet.h, src/interfaces/chain.h, and src/interfaces/node.h to propagate broadcast errors across process boundaries.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "unblocks #1008",
      "rationale": "Extends node and wallet interface methods to return structured broadcast errors needed by multiprocess consumers like the QML GUI. The PR description notes that frontends relying on `interfaces::Wallet::commitTransaction` could not detect rejected transactions because the method returned `void`, unblocking gui-qml#1008."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/net_processing.cpp and .h are mechanical signature adaptations for transaction broadcast helpers and do not alter P2P protocol or relay behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits in src/rpc/mempool.cpp and src/rpc/util.cpp only update call sites to match the new return type without changing RPC interface behavior or outputs.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/test/fuzz/kitchen_sink.cpp solely to adapt an existing caller to the updated broadcast interface signature.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/common/messages.cpp are mechanical updates adjusting to the refactored transaction error types.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled 'Wallet' and modifies CWallet::CommitTransaction() alongside wallet spend and bump fee interfaces.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents wallet frontends from falsely displaying 'Transaction sent' when the node rejects a transaction. The PR description highlights that `CWallet::CommitTransaction()` previously discarded rejections by returning `void`, masking broadcast failures from the user."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
